description: Reports a mistake a devkit skill should have prevented to the devkit's own issue tracker, as a "skill missed" issue drafted from the session where it happened: the request, what Claude did, the fix, and the Umbraco and devkit versions, with confidential details removed. Shows the draft and posts only on the user's yes. Use when the user says Claude got something wrong that the devkit should have caught, or asks to report a skill miss.
